title: Scènes à Faire: an empirical method (code, derived outputs, and Study 1 materials)
description: Code, small derived outputs, and Study 1 materials for Common or Characteristic? An Empirical Method for Scènes à Faire (Kamper, Bartholomew, Patel & Holyoak, manuscript, 2026). From 45,958 film plot summaries in seventeen genres, the pipeline extracts narrative elements and computes each element's prevalence and distinctiveness within each genre, then tests the two measures against held-out films, elements courts have called scènes à faire, and a preregistered human study. Code is licensed MIT; data, documents and derived outputs are licensed CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA). The source corpora and Study 1 participant data are not included.
